{{Otheruses|Darkness}}
'''Darkness''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. Ascendants using this spell could cloak a selected area in a sphere of darkness for a period of time. Anyone caught in the field of darkness suffered limited vision.
